Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning

Class InjectionWellHydraulics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning.InjectionWellHydraulics
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class InjectionWellHydraulics extends Object implements Serializable
Hydraulics and injectivity of water or gas injection wells with NeqSim fluid properties, a temperature profile, a fracture-pressure limit with thermal stress reduction, and a matrix-injectivity operating point.

The tubing traverse is integrated downward from the wellhead (or upward from the bottom hole) with a flash at each segment, so density changes with pressure and temperature (important for gas and CO2 injection) are included: dP/dL = rho g sin(theta) - f rho v^2 / (2 D) in the direction of flow. Two-phase segments are treated as a no-slip homogeneous mixture and flagged. The matrix injectivity is steady-state radial Darcy flow, q = 2 pi k h (P_bh - P_res) / (mu (ln(r_e/r_w) - 0.75 + s)), with the viscosity and density at bottom-hole conditions. The fracture limit is P_frac = gradient x TVD minus the thermal stress reduction alpha E dT / (1 - nu) (upper bound, full cooling of the rock).

Limitations: screening; no formation-fluid displacement, relative permeability, plugging or skin growth, no fracture propagation or fracture-injection (Hall plot) modelling, no hydrate or scale compatibility (use the hydrate and scale classes), and the thermal stress reduction is an upper bound. Validation is by analytic limits (static column, Darcy-Weisbach, Darcy radial flow) only.
